summary: OpenAI published a customer case study describing how telco SaaS provider Circles uses the OpenAI API and Codex to power an AI Concierge, multi-agent support system, and personalization engine, citing internal metrics on ARPU, churn, resolution rate, and developer efficiency.

mechanisms.reason: The case study describes a customer's own multi-agent support architecture achieving high autonomous resolution, but this is one customer's testimonial, not a stated industry shift.
mechanisms.quote: CareX autonomously resolves 65% of customer service interactions across supported workflows, without human intervention.

practices.reason: The multi-agent routing design (orchestration agent plus specialist agents scoped to task-specific information) is a customer's proprietary architecture description, illustrative but under-specified for direct replication.
practices.quote: It combines an orchestration agent that understands each customer’s history and current activity with specialist agents for billing, subscriptions, network management, and account services.

practices.reason: Describes a governance pattern of PII detection/encryption before data reaches the model and scoped agent access, which is a vendor-side integration pattern worth noting but not a change to OpenAI's own interface.
practices.quote: Circles applies automated controls before customer information reaches the model layer, including identifying and encrypting personally identifiable information before it is passed to LLMs.
